A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same readable 11-page paper, with matching scientific text, equations, figures, tables and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix. Differences are confined to the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original UAVid and RuralScapes segmentation experiments, accuracy and runtime comparisons in Table 1, and sensitivity analyses and ablations in Tables 2–3.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the same original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations and qualitative examples.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain identical similarity-weighted prediction propagation, homography alignment, training losses and temporally consistent knowledge distillation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same urban UAVid and rural RuralScapes aerial video segmentation tasks. No datasets, domains or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same teacher and image-model controls, SegFormer variants, ConvNeXt-S with UPerNet, DFF, NetWarp and both TCB variants. The TFC-style cosine-similarity comparison in Table 3 also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 specify identical splits, class remapping, resolutions, model configurations and training budgets. Evaluation metrics and the 1,000-sample runtime protocol, which excludes registration estimation, are unchanged.

E4.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same consistency-loss weight sweep and ablations of similarity computation, registration, interpolation, consistency loss and one-step training. Figure 4 retains identical qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Both Table 1 captions state that SSP and KD-SSP metrics average three runs. Neither version adds seed information, dispersion estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–3 and qualitative examples match. For example, KD-SSP retains 80.63 mIoU and 91.53 TC on UAVid, and 64.56 mIoU and 94.00 TC on RuralScapes.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations 1–5, loss formulations and planar-ground assumption for homography alignment are identical. No formal reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and accuracy, consistency and efficiency claims, including the stated 12.5% and 6.7% TC improvements over the base image model.

C2.justification: The interpretations of propagation, registration and distillation are unchanged, as are discussions of imperfect alignment, operation without registration and accuracy–consistency trade-offs.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose identical architecture details, hyperparameters, augmentation, software, hardware and timing information. The project-access link is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to earlier methods and all 58 bibliography entries are identical.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin text changes from v1 dated 19 March 2025 to v2 dated 26 June 2025. All paper wording, headings and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp is slightly repositioned. Figures 1–4, Tables 1–3 and the remaining layout are unchanged; rendered pages 2–11 are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information are identical. Updating and slightly repositioning the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in paper quality.
